defects_addressed.class: stale sweeps miss hidden live references
defects_addressed.root_cause: count_live_refs in souji-verify.sh and souji-vault-verify.sh invoked `rg -l --no-ignore --fixed-strings` WITHOUT `--hidden`. ripgrep skips dot-prefixed files by default, so a live reference living in a hidden file (.usage.md, .ufo/..., .gitignore) was invisible: the sweep returned 0 and the stale receipt was issued for an artifact that is still referenced.

fresh_repro_pre_fix.verdict: REPRODUCED on the pre-patch candidate bytes

fix.verify_and_vault: Sweep is now hidden-inclusive (`rg -l --hidden --no-ignore --fixed-strings`). The sweep was factored into `_sweep_refs` so the total and the hidden subset are counted from ONE scan (no double-scan divergence). New `count_hidden_refs` reports how many hits carry a dot-prefixed component; `_is_hidden_path` is the classifier. Evidence strings now carry `hidden-refs=N` on both the veto path (`stale=live-refs=1 hidden-refs=1`) and the SAFE path (`refs=0 hidden-refs=0`).
fix.exclusions_preserved: .git tree, census/tests surfaces, .ufo-quarantine and the artifact's own path stay excluded explicitly; all verified to still prune under --hidden.
fix.quarantine: souji-quarantine.sh delegates its stale verdict to the engine, so it gained an INDEPENDENT `q_stale_facts` re-derivation (own `q_scratch_type`, own hidden-inclusive sweep, own hidden count). It is applied twice: as a PREFLIGHT before any staging, and inside second_check. A hidden-only reference now blocks with the target untouched.

defects_addressed.class: directory staleness must digest the FULL tree
defects_addressed.root_cause: Two related omissions. (a) `try_stale` aged a directory from `stat -c %Y` of the directory ITSELF, so a change confined to an existing descendant left the age unchanged and a fresh descendant could not veto the receipt. (b) `dir_digest` hashed only `find -type f`, so a NEW descendant -- in particular a new EMPTY directory -- left the digest byte-identical and a moved-to-obsidian/ledger or staged-pin receipt stayed valid across tree growth.

fresh_repro_pre_fix.shape: .scratch/old-b/sub/deep.txt rewritten fresh while old-b and sub were backdated 3 days
fresh_repro_pre_fix.observed: VERDICT .../.scratch/old-b SAFE stale scratch-type=scratch-dir refs=0 mtime-age-days=3 (dir mtime 2026-10-15)
fresh_repro_pre_fix.verdict: REPRODUCED on the pre-patch candidate bytes

fix.staleness: For a directory target, age is derived from the newest mtime anywhere in the tree (`find . -printf '%T@\n' | sort -rn | head -1`), with .git pruned. A scope that cannot be read refuses (`stale=tree-mtime-unverifiable`) instead of guessing. File targets keep `stat -c %Y`.
fix.digest: dir_digest now emits the directory skeleton (`find -type d -printf 'd\t%p\0'`) into the manifest alongside the file hashes, so adding or removing any descendant directory changes the digest. Symlinks remain a hard refusal (rc 2) as established in r5.
fix.applies_to: all three tools -- souji-verify.sh (moved-to-obsidian directory rows), souji-vault-verify.sh (directory ledger rows), souji-quarantine.sh (stage-2 pin and the staged-pin second check).

fresh_verification_post_fix.fully_backdated_tree: SAFE stale scratch-type=scratch-dir refs=0 hidden-refs=0 mtime-age-days=3 (no over-refusal)
fresh_verification_post_fix.digest_sensitivity: dir_digest changes when a new EMPTY descendant dir appears (proved by regression G6) and is stable when the tree is unchanged (G7)
